clauses.quote: The original grievance form shall be returned to the grievant.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is management/district returning the form.

clauses.quote: All parties from Levels I and II shall be present at the conference to state their views if requested by either party.
clauses.subject_text: All parties from Levels I and II
clauses.notes: Mutual procedural duty; broadly benefits workers by ensuring grievance hearing participation.

clauses.quote: The Superintendent's designee shall not be the Associate Superintendent, Human Resources or other administrator from the office of Human Resources.
clauses.notes: Restricts management's selection of designee to ensure impartiality in grievance proceedings.

clauses.quote: the grievant, within ten (10) days of the receipt of the Level III response, may request, in writing, that the Association submit the grievance to arbitration.
the Association shall, within fifteen (15) duty days of the receipt of the request, submit a written request to the Superintendent or his/her designee for arbitration of the grievance.

the party raising the question of arbitrability may, upon request, have such question first ruled upon and decided by an arbitrator prior to any other hearing on the merit of the grievance which would thereafter be conducted by a second and different arbitrator.
clauses.subject_text: the party raising the question of arbitrability
clauses.notes: Mutual permission; primarily facilitates worker access to impartial arbitration.

clauses.quote: The fees and expenses of the separate arbitrator deciding the issue of arbitrability shall be borne by the losing party.
clauses.subject_text: The fees and expenses of the separate arbitrator deciding the issue of arbitrability
clauses.notes: Allocates costs to whichever side loses the arbitrability ruling.

clauses.quote: The arbitrator shall be selected by mutual agreement by a representative of the Association and of the District.
clauses.notes: Joint procedural duty; both sides must agree on selection.

clauses.quote: the parties shall request of the State Conciliation Service a list of seven (7) names of persons experienced in hearing grievances.
clauses.notes: Fallback procedure to facilitate arbitration access.

clauses.quote: Each party shall alternately strike a name until only one remains.
clauses.notes: Mutual strike procedure for arbitrator selection.

clauses.quote: The first strike shall be by the Association.
clauses.notes: Assigns procedural advantage to the Union in name-striking.

clauses.quote: The District and the Association shall share equally in the payment for the services and expenses of the arbitrator.
clauses.notes: Joint cost-sharing duty; reduces financial burden on workers.

clauses.quote: All other expenses shall be borne by the party incurring them.
clauses.notes: Standard cost-allocation rule; each side pays its own incidental costs.
